```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(readxl)
CPS2015<-read_excel("CPS2015.xlsx")
```
Part A: Run a regression on AHE on age, sex and education
```{r}
model_1<-lm(ahe~age+female+bachelor, data=CPS2015)
summary(model_1)
```
Part B: Run a regression of log on AHE, Age, Female and Bachelor
```{r}
model_2<-lm(log(ahe)~age+female+bachelor,data=CPS2015)
summary(model_2)
```
Part C: Run a regression of ln(AHE),ln(Age), female,bachelor
```{r}
model_3<-lm(log(ahe)~log(age)+female+bachelor,data=CPS2015)
summary(model_3)
```
Part D: Run a regression of ln(ahe), age, age^2, female, bachelor
```{r}
model_4<-lm(log(ahe)~age+I(age^2)+female+bachelor, data=CPS2015)
summary(model_4)
```
